maintenance_led.reason: Roads, highways and airports include new construction plus resurfacing and maintenance; the website gives no revenue split between them.

publicly_funded.reason: Paving for state and federal agencies, municipalities, airports and military installations; highways funded by federal and state investment.

serial_acquirer.reason: Stated vision is to acquire locally led infrastructure companies; recent Texas, Florida and Oklahoma acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Public paving contracts are competitively bid per project, so agencies can change contractors without much disruption.

notes: Share of revenue from maintenance and resurfacing versus new construction is not stated.
